_comment: Algorithm tuning parameters. Changing these alters the pacing/sensitivity of the pedagogy. Values are ported from the SocraticCode (OpenCode) fork; see socratiskill.txt for rationale.
_calibration_comment: Up-leveling thresholds scale with current level: a novice needs more sustained evidence than an advanced user. Down-leveling stays flat (3/5) because being stuck above your level is worse than being stuck below it.
_authorship_moved: The scaffold_* knobs moved to data/levels.json when the scaffold window became a per-level daily budget. They also changed meaning: the file count used to scale UP with level (a novice was made to type boilerplate for fluency), which inverts under an axis where a higher level means more of the work is yours. The two concerns were then separated — files_per_day is relief from TEDIUM and stays roughly flat, because typing package.json costs the same at every level; statements_per_file is how much of the THINKING is still the agent's, and that is what the level is actually for.
